steps.text: The sun heats the sea. Water rises into the sky as an invisible gas called water vapour. This is evaporation.
What is it called when water vapour cools and forms clouds?
steps.hint: It starts with the letter C.

steps.text: Exactly. Cooling turns the vapour back into tiny drops, and those drops make clouds. This is condensation.
Close. Evaporation is water rising, and precipitation is rain falling. When vapour cools into cloud drops, that is condensation.
When the drops grow heavy, they fall as rain. The rain soaks the ground, reaches the rivers, and flows back to the sea.
You finished the water cycle: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and back to the sea.
